_what: Every choice of the current run. FEATURES.md says what each means.

translation._what: Two slots per translated item. Items taken as correctly reported (the type is married, dependents and the wage band); items whose SCF zero-reporters are partly filled in as hidden holders, in a PUF-concept slot beside the reported one. A zero-reporter's chance of a hidden holding in each size range comes from the reporting-rate formula (train.py); the size ranges are only where reporting rates are read. Fill-ins from pass fill_from_pass.

wage_top_scaling._what: SCF wages above this line (2015 dollars, grown to each wave by SOI) placed on the PUF filers' distribution by count from the top (build_table.py, scale_top_wages); the SCF reports more high earners than tax data at every line.

ages._what: The primary filer's age range (ages.py). Step 0 for PUF records with no range: a logit prior from the return, calibrated to SOI Table 1.6 less the known-range weight in each filing status x AGI cell where at least min_missing_share of the weight has no range. Survey couples: the man is the primary, except the woman with a chance by the man's range that reproduces the PUF's female-primary share by range; same-sex couples, the older partner.

generation._what: A stack of four files of 100,000 PUF records each. Each oversamples the top 1% of one variable (the bands covering the top 1% of its positive weight drawn ten times as often) and carries importance weights that undo it. PUF variables are drawn in a random order per record; the computed totals are then computed from their parts; the balance sheet is drawn last, under the SCF label, with the PUF-only variables left out. The fourth file oversamples business equity, the most concentrated item of the balance sheet (net worth itself is computed, not drawn).

consistency._what: Consistency rules at generation: when any item in when_any_nonzero is nonzero on the record, at least one holding in then_at_least_one_nonzero must be nonzero (generate.py says how). offset_generations: how many times generation runs; after each run but the last, each ruled holding's odds of being nonzero are scaled by one factor so that, with the rules, its expected holders equal the model's own. 1 means no offset.

rules.name: a partnership or S corporation item

tilt._what: Reweighting to 2019: the 136 IRS targets and the non-filer count exact; the 140 SOI business targets exact (2% if the exact tilt does not converge); the eight SCF 2019 wealth targets with a 2% tolerance, counts on the file's units. Filers' starting weights pre-scaled to the 2019 joint and non-joint return counts.
